Using a such a label cover, our construction in Section 4 would imply a hardness of Ω(log1/8 n) in Theorem 2. context: ▶ Remark. The constant δ can be computed explicitly, but we do not attempt to do this here. This construction is described in Section 4. We remark that there are extensive work on improving the soundness in PCP constructions as a function of the number of labels. The best known result in this direction is due to Chan [7] that achieves soundness roughly L−1/2 for L labels. However, Chan’s result does not have perfect completeness and hence cannot be used in our constructions. Roughly speaking, this is because each job must be assigned to some machine (this is similar to the reason that one requires perfect completeness in reducing label cover to set cover, as each element must be covered). ▶ Remark. In personal communication, Amey Bhangale has pointed out that in an unpublished manuscript, they can show that assuming the 2-to-2 conjecture with perfect completeness, there is a label cover instance with L labels that has perfect completeness and soundness L−1/2 . Using a such a label cover, our construction in Section 4 would imply a hardness of Ω(log1/8 n) in Theorem 2.
